title: Ask Sage
subtitle: A local 27B model that cites what it read, on a box with no internet

steps.caption: Sage runs entirely on the appliance. No PHI leaves the box.
Fast mode answers general questions with the small model. Patient, medication and dose questions still go to the careful model. That floor is not a toggle in the UI.
Ask: what are the classic ECG findings in hyperkalaemia?
The answer, with a safety line inline and the guidelines it retrieved listed under "Show details".
